ranking_rule: Pass candidates rank above caution, caution above fail
tie_breaker: If same decision, compare aggregate net PnL

ranking_rule: Higher positive net PnL ranks higher
notes: Negative PnL is fail regardless of other dimensions

ranking_rule: Higher PF ranks higher, with >=1.20 preferred and >=1.10 minimum
notes: PF NA from zero trades is not a pass

ranking_rule: Lower drawdown ranks higher if PnL/PF are comparable
More positive markets and fewer severe weak markets rank higher
Non-negative BTCUSDT preferred when meaningful BTC trades exist
Adequate trade count ranks above low sample
Candidate must report and preferably beat passive BTC risk-adjusted/complexity comparison
